advice.why: Coming to the work with knowing the genre short cost about 2 points of the whole a piece: that’s preparation, not training.

20 hours of its exercise would take it from 54 to about 58, worth about 0.7 points a piece on your recent work (3 of your last 3 pieces read it; it gains most on Tell Me What It Looks Like (Keep The Line Moving), Taped, about +0.8), worked out again with you as you are now, a session a day; about 0.1 of it is the discipline 20 days of practice keep, which any exercise kept up daily would bring. Steady to begin; spaced pays once the last session is a day to a week old. About as useful: Emotional Depth, On Camera; any of them is a sound next step.
